hypotheses.S0_full_patch_recomposition_is_exact: Full finite product patches recompose to maximum logit error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.S1_taylor_direction_degrades_with_radius: Median Taylor-to-midpoint cosine is nonincreasing within tolerance 0.03 as edit scale increases in every cell.
hypotheses.S2_quarter_radius_is_predictable: Taylor-local rank-256 KL recovery is at least 0.70 at scale 0.25 in every cell.
hypotheses.S3_half_radius_remains_useful: Taylor-local rank-256 KL recovery is at least 0.60 at scale 0.50 in every cell.
hypotheses.S4_large_edits_cross_a_locality_boundary: Taylor-local recovery falls by at least 0.20 from scale 0.25 to 1.0 in every cell.
hypotheses.S5_exact_midpoint_rescues_large_edits: Explicit-midpoint-local recovery is at least 0.65 at scale 1.0 in every cell.
hypotheses.S6_truncation_is_a_material_large_edit_c: At scale 1.0 explicit-midpoint-local exceeds frozen Taylor-local by at least 0.10 in every cell.
hypotheses.S7_taylor_beats_random_within_its_local_: At scales 0.25 and 0.50 Taylor-local exceeds random recovery by at least 0.30 in every cell.
hypotheses.S8_radius_frontier_transfers_ood: At every layer and scale, Taylor recovery differs by at most 0.15 between FineWeb and TinyStories.
hypotheses.S9_scales_and_orders_are_frozen: The original sampled sites, learned layer orders, scales, rank, and thresholds are fixed before outcomes.
